title: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce - Business Studies - Factors of Production
exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The various resources fundamentally required by a business to create goods and provide services are collectively referred to as
questions.explain: The resources necessary to carry out the production of goods and services are collectively called the **factors of production**. These include land, labour, capital, and the entrepreneur.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: In the context of production, which factor represents all natural resources and free gifts of nature available on, above, and below the earth's surface?
questions.explain: **Land** is defined broadly in economics as all natural resources and free gifts of nature, which includes not just soil, but forests, minerals, water bodies, and climate.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The financial reward or compensation given to the owner of land for its use in the production process is called
questions.explain: Each factor of production earns a reward. The payment made for the use of land and its natural resources is referred to as **rent**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: All human efforts, whether physical or mental, directed towards the creation of goods and services for a reward are termed
questions.explain: **Labour** encompasses all human physical exertion and mental intelligence that is applied during the production process in exchange for a reward.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: What is the economic reward paid to labour for its contribution to production?
questions.explain: Workers (labour) are compensated for their physical and mental efforts with **Wages and Salaries**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Man-made assets or accumulated wealth utilized specifically to facilitate the further production of wealth are classified as
questions.explain: **Capital** represents the man-made resources—such as machinery, cash, buildings, and vehicles—that are used to assist in the production of other goods and services.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: All of the following are practical examples of capital as a factor of production EXCEPT
questions.explain: Factory machineries, delivery vans, and business funds are all man-made assets (Capital). **Rivers and natural forests** are free gifts of nature, making them examples of Land.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The specific economic reward earned by individuals or institutions that provide capital for business operations is
questions.explain: When money or assets are invested as capital in a business, the return or reward yielded to the provider of that capital is called **interest**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The factor of production that coordinates the other factors, makes key decisions, and bears the risks associated with the business is the
questions.explain: The **entrepreneur** is the organizer and risk-taker who brings together land, labour, and capital to initiate the production process and drive the business.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The ultimate reward an entrepreneur receives for successfully bearing business risks and organizing production effectively is
questions.explain: Because the entrepreneur assumes all the uncertainties and risks of the business, their designated reward is **profit** (or they suffer the consequence of a loss).
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following statements best describes the relationship between the factors of production?
options: Land can produce goods independently without any human intervention.
Capital is naturally occurring and requires no prior labour to exist.
The entrepreneur relies solely on capital, rendering labour and land useless.
The entrepreneur combines land, labour, and capital to successfully produce goods.
questions.explain: No single factor can produce goods on its own. **The entrepreneur must combine land, labour, and capital** in the right proportions to ensure the successful creation of goods and services.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A commercial farmer uses an automated tractor to cultivate a large plot of farmland. In this scenario, the tractor and the farmland respectively represent which two factors of production?
questions.explain: The automated tractor is a man-made machine used for further production, which represents **Capital**. The farmland is a natural resource, which represents **Land**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies
